a:r.a:t: mRNA Sequences That Serve as Signals for Initiation of Protein Synthesis in Bacteria

p:cNvPr.descr: Messenger RNA sequence that serve as signals for initiation of protein synthesis in bacteria. In image (a), the top line begins with E. coli trpA. This line originates with (5’), then AGCAC, followed by GAG in a pink box, then G, then GG in a pink box, followed by AAAUCUG. Following this is a blue box with AUG, followed by GAACGCUAC, then (3’). The next line is E. coli araB and is UUUGGAU, followed by a pink box with GGAG, then UGAAACG, then a blue box with AUG, then GCGAUUGCA. The next line is E. coli lacl and is CAAUUCAG, followed by a pink box with GGUG, then G, then U in a pink box, then GAAU. Following this is a blue box with GUG, followed by AAACCAGUA. The next line is [phi]X174 phage A protein and begins as AAUCUU, then a pink box with GGAGG, then CUUUUUU, followed by a blue box with AUG, then GUUCGUUCU. The bottom line is Alpha phage cro and begins with AUGUAC, followed by a pink box with UAAGGAGGU, then UGU, then AUG in a blue box, then GAACAACGC. The pink box has a bracket below this, labeled as Shine-Dalgarno sequence; pairs with 16S rRNA. The blue box has a bracket below, labeled as initiation codon; pairs with fMet-tRNA[fMet superscripted]. Image (b) at the bottom has bacterial mRNA with consensus Shine-Dalgarno sequence. It originates with (5’) then continues with GAUUCCU, followed by AGGAGGU in a pink box, then UUGACCU, then a blue box with AUG followed by CGA, GCU, UUU. AGU, followed by (3’). Above the pink box are three stacked blue lines (hydrogen bond) above each letter, where A bonds up to U, G bond sup to C, G bonds up to C, A bonds up to U, G bonds up to C, G bonds up to C, and U bonds up to A. Above the first U and going up is U, then A which bonds up to OH. Atop this is 3’. The final A that is bonded by U also has letter going upward beginning with C, then U, then A, then G, then three dashed lines.
